general_information.Syllabus Name: Microservices with Spring Cloud_Microservices với Spring Cloud
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 145-minute final exam +102.6h self-study
general_information.Description: Upon completion of this course students shoud: 1. Understand the followings: • Microservices, Microservices architecture. • The basics of Spring Cloud and its architecture • The configuration and implementation using Spring Cloud • The microservices architecture using Spring Cloud. • The deployment of microservices-based applications using Docker and Spring Cloud tools 2. Be able to: • Explain about Microservices architecture and its benefits, including scalability, resilience, and fault tolerance. • Explain about Spring Cloud and its architecture • Configure and implement Spring Cloud in a project • Design and implement a microservices architecture using Spring Cloud • Design, build, and deploy microservices-based applications using Docker and Spring Cloud tools 3. Be able to work in team and present group's results
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: - Internet - IntelliJ IDEA or Sping Tool 4 for Eclipse/Visual Studio Code - JDK 20 - Platform: SpringBoot 3

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand of Microservices architecture and its benefits, including scalability, resilience, and fault tolerance.
Understand the basics of Spring Cloud and its architecture
Design and implement a microservices architecture using Spring Cloud.
Design, build, and deploy microservices-based applications using Docker and Spring Cloud tools, including configuration and management of services
